paper_id: SRMF_ A Data Augmentation and Multimodal Fusion Approach for Long-Tail UHR Satellite Image Segmentation
title: SRMF: A Data Augmentation and Multimodal Fusion Approach for Long-Tail UHR Satellite Image Segmentation
venue: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
motivation: 现有UHR遥感分割方法专注于多分支网络架构的多尺度特征提取，忽视了长尾类别分布这一根本性数据问题
problem_framing: 将长尾分布建模为梯度更新方向冲突问题：头类像素对尾类产生反向梯度效应，需通过数据重采样和外部知识注入来平衡
key_insight: 利用预训练视觉语言模型提取通用文本特征作为特征空间中心，在无单图标注情况下实现多模态融合引导分割
method_signature: MARS多尺度锚定区域采样+SRR-TA语义重排序重采样+VLMs文本特征注入的三段式增强框架
evaluation_criteria: mIoU作为主要指标，在URUR、GID、FBP三个数据集上与SOTA方法对比
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: SRR-TA严重依赖SAM-HQ检测结果；若尾类未被检测到，对应类别性能会显著下降；未见类别出现时融合性能会退化
evidence_for_taste: existing methods do not take into account the impact of the long-tail problem
neither random cropping nor multi-scale center cropping achieves the performance level of MSAR
If tail categories are absent in the detected regions, the corresponding class performance will degrade significantly
gradients generated by all pixels that do not belong to this category within a batch will have an opposing effect
establishing a representative center for each category can guide the model's learning process
thinking_moves: 从梯度反向理论推导长尾分布的数学本质，而非仅凭经验观察数据不平衡
将分类领域的重采样策略迁移至像素级分割任务，并针对性设计区域级重采样
借用NLP领域VLM的文本知识作为隐式特征空间中心，弥补尾类样本不足
通过消融实验验证每个组件的必要性，而非黑箱式叠加
